title: Design peer registry data model (peers table in SQLite)
description:
Define the schema for the peers table: peer_id (libp2p PeerId, text PK), address (text), last_seen (timestamp), articles_accepted (integer), articles_rejected (integer), consecutive_failures (integer), blacklisted_until (timestamp nullable), configured (boolean — true if in config file, false if discovered). Artifact: a migration file and docs/peer_registry_schema.md.

Acceptance: schema documented; migration file present; all fields have clear semantics described
